lab_game_reconnect: Reconnecting… Your position is kept. Server clocks continue.
lab_game_result_description: {reason}. Saved in the laboratory; no rating changes.
lab_game_wait_description: The game starts when both seats are ready. Clocks are stopped until then.
lab_game_friend_choice: Your friend is choosing a whole pair. The server will reveal each accepted action here.
lab_game_friend_play: Your friend is playing the confirmed pair. The server will reveal each accepted action here.
lab_game_friend_roll: Your friend is rolling. The server will reveal each accepted action here.
lab_game_first_description: Roll once to reveal both pairs. Then choose one whole pair.
lab_game_second_description: Your first pair is kept. Finish the interrupted roll to reveal the second pair.
lab_game_choice_description: Select one whole pair, then confirm. Confirmation is final.
lab_game_equal: Both pairs are equal; either may be chosen.
lab_game_play_description: The confirmed pair is locked. Select a piece and a highlighted destination; submit the complete turn.
lab_game_pass_description: You may choose a pair without legal moves. The server then passes the turn.
lab_game_board_help: Use arrow keys to explore the board. Select a piece, then a highlighted destination. Escape clears the selection.
